name: Virtual Staging AI
summary: One-click virtual staging for real-estate photos, including furniture removal, with a turnaround the site puts at about 10 seconds.
description: One-click virtual staging for real-estate photos, including furniture removal, with a turnaround the site puts at about 10 seconds.

pricing.details: Monthly and yearly list the same effective monthly rate (yearly billed as 12× the official monthly amount). Basic 14 €/month, or 174 €/year — 6 photos/month. Standard 17 €/month, or 206 €/year — 20 photos/month, image storage forever. Professional 35 €/month, or 423 €/year — 60 photos/month, image storage forever, success manager. Enterprise 71 €/month, or 858 €/year — 150 photos/month, API access, image storage forever, enterprise support with a success manager. A slider for more photos beyond Enterprise is mentioned without further public prices and is left unlisted. Official per-photo rates in the source currency are kept in the official notes (several would be misleading once rounded to whole euros). A free image-editing trial is included on the paid plans; no lasting 0 € staging plan was stated — labelled Premium.
